cases.title: Authentication middleware is configured and activated
JWT issuer, audience, signature and lifetime are validated
Admin-only registration is enforced by the API
Registration is absent from public and manager navigation
Private React routes have role guards
Password and role changes invalidate old access tokens
Login and password recovery are rate limited
Reset tokens are random, hashed, short-lived and non-enumerating
Document resources require authentication and village scope
Public marketing DTO excludes resident and document fields
Purchase orders require manager or admin authorization
Non-marketing uploads require an authenticated request
Security headers and API no-store caching are applied
CORS uses an explicit origin allow-list
Secrets, personal uploads and real-user seed are not tracked
CI runs build, audit, secret scan, unit and integration tests
